name: Encrypted Navdata
description: Partially corrupted navigation core; fenced data brokers pay well for it. Half the files are checksums and the other half are somebody's berth bookings.

name: Alloy Scrap
description: Twisted plating and hull fragments scooped from wrecks. The refinery does not ask what it used to be.

name: Iced Core
description: Cryogenically sealed reactor core pulled from tougher rats. It is still warm when it comes out, which is the part the fringe writes papers about.

name: Hierarch's Crest
description: Salvage from a Pušťov hierarch: a polished identification crest worth a fortune. What it identifies is a question with an invoice attached — the Kanžar Inspectorate buys crests and does not say why.
